title: Steam
description: Buy, install and play your PC games, all from one place.
longDescription:
Valve's storefront and launcher for PC games, running since 2003. Buy a game once and it stays on your account: install it on any machine you sign in to, and it keeps itself updated in the background.

Your saves travel with you through Steam Cloud, so a game picked up on another PC carries on where you left it. Games track achievements, many support mods through the Workshop, and friends, chat and invites are built in.

Steam is free. The games are not, and each is bought separately.

It is a normal Windows program, so Playfront installs it and hands it the screen with the pointer, the same way it does with any other. Steam's own Big Picture mode is worth turning on here: it is their controller-first interface, made for exactly this kind of screen.

title: Spotify – Music and Podcasts
description: Soundtrack your gaming. Listen to music and podcasts for free
longDescription:
Take your gaming further with music and podcasts running behind it. Play your own artists, albums, songs and playlists, or pick one of the gaming playlists Spotify puts together. Drive it from the controller, or change the track from your phone or tablet without putting the game down.

Listen for free, or drop the ads with Premium.

•  Enjoy podcasts too
•  Browse artists, albums, songs and playlists

•  Or with Spotify Connect on your phone or tablet
•  High quality audio, no ads (Premium only)
